// The view at List: its curators, a like button, and its practices with this list's tags.
use "data/schema.vad"
use "parts/cards.vad" (PracticeCard, Avatar)
use "mutations.vad" (toggleListReaction)

view(id):
  state showTags = true

  <Shell title={l.name}
    for={l in List} where={l.id == id}
    fallback={<Shell title="List unavailable" />}>

    <Row slot="subtitle">
      <Text style="secondary">a list by</Text>
      <Avatar person={l.owner} />
      <Avatar person={c} for={c in l.contributors.person} where={c != l.owner} orderBy={c.name} />
    </Row>

    <Button slot="actions" action={toggleListReaction(l: l)}
      if={l.visibility == Public, me != null}>
      👍 {count(l.reactions)}
    </Button>
    <Toggle slot="actions" value={showTags}>Tags</Toggle>

    <Markdown source={l.about} />

    <Grid columns={3}>
      <Column for={i in l.items}>
        <PracticeCard p={i.practice} />
        <Row if={showTags}>
          <Badge color={t.color} for={t in i.practice.tags} where={t.list == l}>{t.name}</Badge>
        </Row>
      </Column>
    </Grid>
  </Shell>

// Search and sort practices. The search text is state, so it never leaves the device:
// the host returns every practice and the client filters them.
use "data/schema.vad"
use "parts/cards.vad"

view():
  state q = ""
  keep sortBy = "name"

  <Shell title="Practices">
    <Row slot="actions">
      <TextField value={q} placeholder="Search" />
      <Button action={set(sortBy, "name")} selected={sortBy == "name"}>A–Z</Button>
      <Button action={set(sortBy, "authors")} selected={sortBy == "authors"}>Most authors</Button>
    </Row>
    <Grid columns={3}>
      <PracticeCard p={p}
        for={p in Practice} where={q == "" or q in p.name}
        orderBy={sortBy == "name" ? p.name : count(p.authors) desc}
        fallback={<Text style="secondary">No practices match “{q}”.</Text>} />
    </Grid>
  </Shell>
files./supplies/Profile.vad:
// A person's page. There are no per-table read rules: what a view may read is what its
// caller may read.
use "data/schema.vad"
use "parts/cards.vad"

rule curatedBy(l List, person Person):
  l.owner == person
rule curatedBy(l List, person Person):
  person in l.contributors.person

view(id):
  <Shell title={person.name} subtitle="@{person.handle}"
    for={person in Person} where={person.id == id}
    fallback={<Shell title="Profile not found" />}>

    <Section title="Practices">
      <Grid columns={3}>
        <PracticeCard p={p} for={p in Practice} where={person in p.authors} orderBy={p.name} />
      </Grid>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Lists featuring their practices">
      <Grid columns={2}>
        <ListCard list={l} for={l in List} where={person in l.items.practice.authors} />
      </Grid>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Lists they curate">
      <Grid columns={2}>
        <ListCard list={l} for={l in List} where={curatedBy(l, person)} orderBy={l.name} />
      </Grid>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Collaborators">
      <Row>
        <Avatar person={other}
          for={p in Practice, other in p.authors} where={person in p.authors, other != person}
          orderBy={other.name} />
      </Row>
    </Section>

    <Section title="Who wrote what with them">
      <Text for={p in Practice, other in p.authors} where={person in p.authors, other != person}>
        {other.name} on {p.name}
      </Text>
    </Section>
  </Shell>
files./supplies/Timer.vad:
// A widget with its own tables, declared beside the view that uses them.

my table Lap:  // one viewer's rows, across the whole app
  at    Date
  label Text

mutation lap(label Text):
  Lap(at: now, label: label)

view(minutes Int?):  // configuration is the view block's attributes
  state running = false  // state x = v is a one-row session table
  state elapsed = 0
  every 1s → set(elapsed, running ? elapsed + 1 : elapsed)

  <Column>
    <Text style="heading">{elapsed} s of {(minutes ?? 25) * 60}</Text>
    <Row>
      <Button action={set(running, not running)}>{running ? "Stop" : "Start"}</Button>
      <Button action={lap(label: "Lap " + (count(Lap) + 1))}>Lap</Button>
    </Row>
    <Text for={l in Lap} orderBy={l.at desc}>{l.label}</Text>
  </Column>

files./supplies/data/schema.vad:
// Supplies' schema, in the one language. A collection's data tables can only be
// declared here; views, rules and mutations may sit beside them.
// Was: examples/supplies/data/schema.usl.

main table List:
  name        Text
  about       Markdown?
  visibility  Visibility
  kind        ListKind
  openToEdits Bool
  owner       Person
  @index(owner, modified)  // my lists, newest first

List.owner      <-> Person.ownedLists[]
List.visibility <-> Visibility.lists[]
List.kind       <-> ListKind.lists[]

table Practice:
  name  unique Text
  about Markdown?

Practice.authors[] <-> Person.practices[]

// A connection table, because tags hang off it.
table Item:
  ordered List.items[]
  Practice.items[]

// A tag's id is unique only within its list.
table Tag (list, id):
  name  Text
  color Text? ~color

Tag.list        <-> List.tags[]
Tag.practices[] <-> Practice.tags[]

table Reaction:
  List.reactions[]
  Person.reactions[]
  emoji Text

table Contribution:
  List.contributors[]
  Person.contributions[]
  first Date = today  // a default, written only when the row is created
  last  Date

enum Visibility:
  Public
  Private

enum ListKind:
  Standard
  Tagged

// --------------------------------------------------------------- arrangements
// What `~views` used to say: ordinary views over the standard Rows element, which
// Story draws natively and lets readers edit. Addressed as data/schema?view=ByOwner.

view ByOwner():
  <Rows for={l in List} group={l.owner} orderBy={l.modified desc}>
    <Bullet value={l.visibility} />
    <Text>{l.name}</Text>
    <Count of={l.items} />
  </Rows>

// Rules and mutations: ../mutations.vad (they could sit here just as well).

// Views drawn as elements. Used with: use "parts/cards.vad" (ListCard, PracticeCard)
use "../data/schema.vad"

view ListCard(list List):
  <Card>
    <Row>
      <Link style="heading" to="List?id={list.id}">{list.name}</Link>
      <Text style="secondary">{count(list.items)} practices</Text>
    </Row>
    <Markdown source={list.about} />
  </Card>

view PracticeCard(p Practice):
  <Card>
    <Link style="heading" to="Practice?id={p.id}">{p.name}</Link>
    <Row>
      <Text style="secondary">by</Text>
      <Avatar person={a} for={a in p.authors} orderBy={a.name} />
    </Row>
    <Markdown source={p.about} lines={6} />
  </Card>

view Avatar(person Person):
  <Link to="Profile?id={person.id}">
    <Portrait src={person.portrait} name={person.name} />
    {person.name}
  </Link>
